sn20.8:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Vesāliyaṃ viharati Mahāvane Kuṭāgārasālāyaṃ || || 2
sn20.8:1.5: Bhadante ti te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassossuṃ || ||
sn20.8:2.1: Kaliṅgarūpadhānā bhikkhave etarahi Licchavī viharanti appamattā ātāpino upāsanasmiṃ || ||
sn20.8:2.2: Tesam rājā Māgadho Ajātasattu vedehiputto na labhati otāraṃ na labhati ārammaṇam || || 4
sn20.8:2.3: Bhavissanti bhikkhave anāgatam addhānaṃ Licchavī sukhumālā mudutaluṇahatthapādā ||
sn20.8:2.4: te mudukā suseyyā sutulabimbohanāsu yāva sūriyuggamanā seyyaṃ kappessanti || ||
sn20.8:2.5: Tesaṃ rājā Māgadho Ajātasattu vedehiputto lacchati otāraṃ lacchati ārammaṇaṃ || || 5
sn20.8:3.1: Kaliṅgarūpadhānā bhikkhave etarahi bhikkhū viharanti appamattā ātāpino padhānasmiṃ || ||
sn20.8:3.2: Tesam Māro pāpimā na labhati otāraṃ na labhati ārammanaṃ || || 6
sn20.8:3.3: Bhavissanti bhikkhave anāgatam addhānam bhikkhū sukhumālā mudutaluṇahatthapādā ||
sn20.8:3.4: te mudukā suseyyā sutūlabimbohanāsu yāva sūriyuggamanā seyyaṃ kappessanti || ||
sn20.8:3.5: Tesam Māro pāpimā lacchati otāram lacchati ārammaṇam || || 7
sn20.8:3.6: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ || ||
